note: The approval prompt is answered by piping 'y' (the recorder does not type): the pipe is visible on screen, the prompt and the model are real. 'result' is a second real run of the same command (the model may choose differently); cut both screens from whichever take matches the narration.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-5 -l swedencentral -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-5 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Remove-Item Env:OPENAI_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # keeps the generic client on Azure
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m apagent.run --endpoint $env:AOAI --deployment chat --approve none | Out-Null   # warm-up
teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-5 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
